findings.title: Outbound webhook idempotency is non-atomic in the API and absent in the worker dispatcher
findings.note: lib/webhook-dispatcher.ts:182-200 and worker/tasks/webhook-dispatcher.ts:104-120 claim atomically per endpoint and carry Idempotency-Key; delivery rows upsert on the key.

findings.title: M365 webhook auth depends on `M365_CLIENT_STATE` which the deploy pipeline does not write, while `M365_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is dead config
findings.note: M365_CLIENT_STATE is written by deploy-do.yml envs and compose; the handler 501s when unset (webhooks.ts:869-875); M365_WEBHOOK_SECRET no longer exists in env.ts/.env.example/compose.

findings.title: M365 inbound notifications have no enforced timestamp/replay window
findings.note: webhooks.ts:37,925 claims with a 7-day TTL, but logWebhookDelivery (webhooks.ts:64-92) then calls storeIdempotencyKey, which hardcodes the 24h IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_SECONDS (lib/idempotency.ts:50,142-145) and overwrites the key — the effective replay window is 24h; after it a duplicate collides with the delivery-row unique key (see WH-P3-010).

findings.title: Inline dispatcher records a fixed `retry_count` and duplicates the worker's retry logic
findings.note: retry_count records result.attempts and failed rows are marked dead_letter with the single retry owner enforced (lib/webhook-dispatcher.ts:255-290).

findings.title: Outbound and DLQ delivery outcomes are not metered; only inbound success increments the counter
findings.note: recordWebhookDelivery/recordWebhookDeadLetter wired on API and worker paths; mct-webhook-* alert rules consume them.

findings.title: Inbound Jira/JSM signature falls back to re-serialized JSON when `req.rawBody` is absent
findings.note: rawBodyBuffer fails closed when req.rawBody is absent (webhooks.ts:661-667,769-775); express.json verify captures Buffer bytes.

findings.title: `webhook_dead_letters` has no DELETE policy while the API deletes via the RLS client
findings.note: 5302452 adds the manage-scoped DELETE policy plus assertion.

findings.title: No per-provider payload schema or size cap on webhook ingress (global 10mb JSON limit)
findings.note: middleware/webhook-body.ts:20-40,62-80 per-provider caps (stripe 1mb, jira/jsm 512kb, m365 256kb) + webhook-schemas.ts minimal shapes before HMAC/clientState.

findings.title: Webhook endpoint and delivery reads are available to any org member (not manage-gated)
findings.note: routes/webhook-management.ts reads require webhooks:view (103,125,348,508) and mutations webhooks:manage.

findings.title: Webhook signing secrets are stored plaintext with no rotation or expiry
findings.note: 5302441_webhook_endpoint_secret_metadata.sql + dispatchers decrypt via decryptSecretValue and dead-letter on decrypt failure instead of sending unsigned (lib/webhook-dispatcher.ts:210-235).

findings.title: Webhook SSRF guard has a DNS-rebinding TOCTOU window
findings.note: pinnedFetch used on all four outbound call sites (api lib/webhook-dispatcher.ts:81-98, worker webhook-dispatcher.ts:206-215, webhook-retry.ts:196-205, module-tasks.ts:611-620).

findings.title: No alerting when webhook dead-letters accumulate or payment reconciliation drifts
findings.note: prometheus.rules.yml:219-253 (DLQ growth + failure ratio) and :348-367 (stripe reconciliation drift) with unit tests.

findings.title: Admin dead-letter retry of inline-dispatched failures no-ops and deletes the DLQ row
findings.note: routes/webhook-management.ts:230-245 refuses summary-only dead letters with 409 and keeps the row.

findings.title: `webhook-retry` has no row claim: concurrent retry runs can double-send deliveries
findings.note: worker/tasks/webhook-retry.ts:12-45 claims each row by moving next_retry_at (lease) before sending.

findings.title: Test endpoint generates a random idempotency key and never dedups
findings.note: routes/webhook-management.ts:56,558-568 deterministic test-ping key + atomic claim + deduplicated response; upsert at 609-628.

findings.title: No committed event catalog or webhook documentation for consumers
findings.note: docs/WEBHOOKS.md event catalog generated from the SDK catalog with a CI test (webhook-event-catalog.test.ts).

findings.title: Worker queued webhook dispatcher inserts deliveries without an idempotency key
findings.note: worker dispatcher derives/carries the idempotency key (worker/tasks/webhook-dispatcher.ts:47-64,104-120).

findings.title: Webhook raw body typed as `string` but consumed as `Buffer`
findings.note: captureRawBody stores a Buffer (middleware/webhook-body.ts:41-50); Stripe verifies the captured bytes (webhooks.ts:273-283).

findings.title: Retried deliveries replay a body without the envelope `timestamp` (payload drift)
findings.note: retries replay the persisted request_body verbatim (worker/tasks/webhook-retry.ts:121-145).

findings.title: Delivery inserts ignore unique-key conflicts, losing the successful-attempt record
findings.note: persistDelivery upserts on idempotency_key (lib/webhook-dispatcher.ts:23-40).

findings.title: Outbound webhook response bodies are read without a size cap
findings.note: lib/pinned-fetch.ts:23-24 MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES=64KiB enforced with stream close.

findings.title: M365 handler processes only the first notification in a batch (value[0])
findings.note: webhooks.ts:905-947 processes every notification in value[].

findings.title: No retention/cleanup for webhook_deliveries and webhook_dead_letters
findings.note: retention.ts:105-115,158-164 purges webhook_deliveries (90d) and dead letters (180d) in bounded batches; 5302454 adds created_at indexes; docs/modules/webhooks.md documents the windows.

findings.title: Provider redelivery after the dedup TTL fails permanently with 500 (unique delivery-log key not conflict-handled)
findings.note: webhooks.ts:64-92 logWebhookDelivery throws AppError DB_ERROR on any insert error; webhook_deliveries.idempotency_key is unique (5302053:14-25); the dedup claim expires at 24h (lib/idempotency.ts:50), so a Stripe dashboard redelivery / Graph replay 24h..90d later claims fresh, then collides on insert -> persistent 500 to the provider (claim released on every retry). Contrast: webhook-management.ts:266-270 handles 23505 for DLQ replays. New finding (P3).

report: Read-only re-verification at `7dd0402`; no live webhook traffic. 22 of 23 previous WH rows verified fixed, 1 partially fixed, 0 regressed, 1 new P3. Executed: `promtool check rules` + `test rules` against `infra/digitalocean/prometheus.rules.yml` (22 rules SUCCESS). Key code: `lib/webhook-dispatcher.ts`, `worker/tasks/{webhook-dispatcher,webhook-retry}.ts`, `routes/{webhooks,webhook-management}.ts`, `lib/idempotency.ts`, `middleware/webhook-body.ts`, `lib/webhook-schemas.ts`; migrations 5302053/5302441/5302452/5302454. Residual: the M365 7-day replay claim is re-stored with the shared 24h TTL by `logWebhookDelivery` (WH-P2-001). New: WH-P3-010 (provider redelivery after the dedup TTL collides with the unique delivery key and 500s permanently).
